source_texts.source_text:
UTC calendar date of the user-day: a day with qualifying activity or a valid purchase. Partition column.
Granularity: per user-day
Source: int_user_daily_activity.date_dim, int_user_daily_purchase.date_dim (row spine)

Granularity: one row per user_id, date_dim (UTC) on days with qualifying activity (`int_user_daily_activity`) or at least one valid purchase (`int_user_daily_purchase`). Purchase-only days have is_active_day = FALSE, so count DAU with COUNTIF(is_active_day), not COUNT(*). Partitioned by date_dim, clustered by user_id.

source_texts.source_text:
TRUE when the user has qualifying activity on the day (at least one activity-stream event other than identify_as_event and app_gain_focus); FALSE on purchase-only rows. Never NULL. Use COUNTIF(is_active_day) for DAU.
Granularity: per user-day
Calculation: an int_user_daily_activity row exists for (user_id, date_dim)
Source: int_user_daily_activity

Granularity: one row per user_id, date_dim (UTC) on days with qualifying activity (`int_user_daily_activity`) or at least one valid purchase (`int_user_daily_purchase`). Purchase-only days have is_active_day = FALSE, so count DAU with COUNTIF(is_active_day), not COUNT(*). Partitioned by date_dim, clustered by user_id.

TRUE when the user is a special user (tester or internal account) in int_special_user. Current-state value joined on user_id only, so it reflects the profile when the partition was last written: a user flagged later stays FALSE on older partitions until they are rebuilt or backfilled. Never NULL on partitions written since 2026-10-22 (older ones are NULL until backfilled). Filter on is_special_user = FALSE to exclude testers and internal accounts.
Granularity: per user (same on every row of the user written in the same run)
Calculation: COALESCE(dim_user_profile.is_special_user, FALSE)
Source: dim_user_profile.is_special_user (from int_special_user)

Filters: date_dim >= daily_activity_full_refresh_start_date (2024-09-02) on a full refresh; the last purchase_late_arrival_days + 1 (8) days on incremental runs. No user filter: special users, testers and deactivated users are included; special users are marked by is_special_user, so dashboards should filter is_special_user = FALSE. Purchase columns count valid purchases only (`int_purchase.is_valid_purchase`, applied in `int_user_daily_purchase`); the rule is described on `int_purchase_revenue.is_valid_purchase`. Session, ad and gameplay data for a user-day outside the row spine is dropped. The current UTC date is included, so the latest day is partial until the next run rebuilds it.

records.note: source: NULL on partitions written before 2026-10-22; this filter drops NULL rows, so it is only valid for dates written since 2026-10-22

source_texts.source_text: Filters: date_dim >= daily_activity_full_refresh_start_date (2024-09-02) on a full refresh; the last purchase_late_arrival_days + 1 (8) days on incremental runs. No user filter: special users, testers and deactivated users are included; special users are marked by is_special_user, so dashboards should filter is_special_user = FALSE. Purchase columns count valid purchases only (`int_purchase.is_valid_purchase`, applied in `int_user_daily_purchase`); the rule is described on `int_purchase_revenue.is_valid_purchase`. Session, ad and gameplay data for a user-day outside the row spine is dropped. The current UTC date is included, so the latest day is partial until the next run rebuilds it.

Ad revenue for the user-day, AppLovin-first: AppLovin revenue when AppLovin has rows for the user-day, otherwise the client-reported rewarded-ad revenue. 0 on active days with no ad revenue. NULL on purchase-only rows and before 2025-08-01. The latest 1-3 days usually carry the rewarded-ad estimate (~10% low) and switch to AppLovin on a later run.
Granularity: per user-day
Calculation: COALESCE(COALESCE(SUM(AppLovin revenue), SUM(ad_watch_completed revenue)), 0) (in int_user_daily_ad_revenue)
Source: int_user_daily_ad_revenue.ad_revenue

- Incremental runs rebuild the last purchase_late_arrival_days + 1 days with insert_overwrite (the same window as `int_user_daily_purchase`), so late purchases and late AppLovin revenue reach this model. They read this table's stored rows only for the latest stored state per user and country_code and the user's highest total_active_days before the window.

records.note: source states: current UTC day partial; last 8 days rebuilt on incremental runs; latest 1-3 days of ad_revenue usually an estimate ~10% low
